meta.title: Serving Cutover: Resolve the Alias, Stand Up, Canary, Full Cutover

views.label: Never carry the source version number
views.note: entity_version copied from source is valid in the target and silently serves a different model.

views.label: Incremental, not a DNS flip
views.note: Target stands up alongside the still-running source; traffic moves in canary percentages, not all at once.

views.label: Monitoring history stays behind
views.note: The accumulated payload table is history in the source metastore — it migrates only if someone puts it in scope.

cards.title: The version number is the trap, again
items: entity_version copied from source is valid in the target and serves a different model — silently, no error
Pin the deployment to an alias intent ("serve champion"), resolve the version number only at deploy time
Serving endpoints take a number, not an alias — resolution has to happen in the deploy script

cards.title: Zero downtime means overlap, not a flip
items: Stand up target alongside the still-running source, don't replace it yet
Canary a small traffic percentage before an all-at-once DNS flip
Keep source warm through hypercare as the rollback target

cards.title: Inference tables are two separate problems
items: The auto_capture_config must point at a target catalog and schema — copying it verbatim breaks
The accumulated payload table is monitoring history that migrates only if someone scopes it
Log delivery is best-effort — don't reconcile row-for-row during a dual-run window, compare a closed window instead
